📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-08
1. Gitea Patches Critical CVSS 9.8 Vulnerability Allowing Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution資安
Gitea修補CVSS 9.8重大漏洞，攻擊者無須登入即可遠端執行程式碼
Gitea disclosed CVE-2026-59774, a critical flaw letting unauthenticated attackers read server files via a public repository's file-handling feature and potentially achieve remote code execution. The CVSS score is 9.8, and the fix ships in Gitea 1.27.1.
開源Git服務平台Gitea揭露重大漏洞CVE-2026-59774，遠端攻擊者無須登入帳號，只要伺服器上有可公開存取的儲存庫，就可能透過檔案處理功能讀取內部檔案，取得存取權杖後甚至可執行任意程式碼，CVSS評分達9.8分，已於Gitea 1.27.1修補。

2. OpenAI Pauses In-Development Astra Model Over Critical Cybersecurity Capabilities模型
OpenAI暫停開發中的Astra模型，因其網路攻擊能力被判定過於強大
OpenAI says it has paused internal work on its in-development Astra model because it reached a "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks on well-protected systems. The move follows OpenAI's disclosure that its models accidentally hacked Hugging Face.
OpenAI表示已暫停開發中模型Astra的內部作業，因其已達「關鍵網路安全門檻」，代表該模型可能自主識別並發動針對高防護系統的網路攻擊，此舉緊接在OpenAI揭露其模型意外入侵Hugging Face事件之後。
The Verge · 原文連結
3. NPM Package Keyv Supply Chain Attack "ChainDrop" Traced Back to Shai-Hulud Campaign資安
NPM套件Keyv供應鏈攻擊活動ChainDrop傳出源自於Shai-Hulud
The npm package keyv was compromised on August 4, contaminating 444 packages within four hours and publishing 2,212 malicious versions. Multiple security firms say the worm used, ChainDrop, confirms this is part of the larger Shai-Hulud supply chain attack.
NPM套件keyv於8月4日遭入侵，4小時內造成444個套件被污染，攻擊者上架2,212個惡意版本，多家資安公司指出攻擊所用的蠕蟲程式ChainDrop，證實此事件是大規模供應鏈攻擊Shai-Hulud的一部分。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Judge Rules Meta Caused "Public Nuisance," Orders $567M for Youth Mental Health Treatment政策
法官裁定Meta造成「公共妨害」，須出資5.67億美元治療青少年心理健康問題
A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to fund a $567 million program addressing the youth mental health crisis the company was found to have helped create, ruling its platforms constituted a public nuisance.
新墨西哥州法官裁定Meta的平台構成「公共妨害」，須出資5.67億美元成立基金，協助治療該公司助長的青少年心理健康危機。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
5. Security Researchers Warn Claude's Shared Conversations Can Be Found via Google Search資安
資安業者揭露Claude分享對話可被Google搜尋，恐致用戶敏感資訊意外曝光
Security firm Malwarebytes found that shared conversations from Anthropic's Claude chatbot can be indexed and found via Google Search, risking exposure of users' sensitive information. The issue was first spotted by Reddit users locating such conversation logs through specific search queries.
資安業者Malwarebytes指出，Anthropic AI聊天工具Claude的分享對話可能被Google搜尋引擎索引，導致用戶對話中的敏感資訊意外曝光，此問題最初由Reddit用戶發現，透過特定搜尋方式即可找到大量對話紀錄。
iThome · 原文連結
6. The Messy Politics Behind Google's Big AI Shake-Up產業
Google大規模AI組織重整背後的複雜政治角力
Google announced its largest AI organizational shake-up yet, with several top AI leaders — including Jeff Dean — moving to new roles, some outside the company, as its models appear to lag behind Anthropic and OpenAI.
Google宣布史上最大規模的AI組織重整，包括資深工程師Jeff Dean在內的多位AI要角轉任新職，部分甚至離開公司，此次改組正值Google模型表現似乎落後Anthropic與OpenAI之際。
The Verge · 原文連結
7. ByteDance Trains Massive 10-Trillion-Parameter AI Model to Rival Anthropic模型
抖音母公司字節跳動訓練10兆參數巨型AI模型，意圖挑戰Anthropic
TikTok owner ByteDance is training an AI model with 10 trillion parameters as it seeks to compete with leading labs such as Anthropic.
TikTok母公司字節跳動正在訓練一個擁有10兆參數的巨型AI模型，企圖在AI競賽中挑戰Anthropic等頂尖業者。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
8. Cloudflare Launches Kitesurf, a Browser Built for AI Agents產品
Cloudflare推出專為AI代理打造的瀏覽器Kitesurf
Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents rather than humans, using less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks and helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
Kitesurf是一款專為AI代理設計的雲端瀏覽器，相較Chromium在常見自動化任務上耗用更少運算資源，協助開發者更有效率地打造以瀏覽器為基礎的AI代理。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
9. SpaceX to Invest $16.8B in Texas AI Chip Plant "Terafab"產業
SpaceX斥資168億美元在德州興建AI晶片廠Terafab
Texas Governor Greg Abbott announced that SpaceX will build a vertically integrated AI chip plant called Terafab in Grimes County, Texas, with a first-phase investment exceeding $16.8 billion expected to create 3,000 jobs.
德州州長Greg Abbott宣布，SpaceX將在德州格萊姆斯郡興建垂直整合式AI晶片廠Terafab，第一階段投資超過168億美元，預計創造3,000個工作機會，德州政府也將提供3,000萬美元補助。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Google Open-Sources WeatherNext Model, Cutting Cyclone Forecast Lead Time by a Day研究
Google開源WeatherNext天氣模型，熱帶氣旋預報平均提前一天
Google DeepMind open-sourced the WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones AI weather models, releasing both code and weights. A study published in Nature shows WeatherNext Cyclones can predict cyclone tracks, intensity, and wind radius more than 24 hours earlier than leading models at the same accuracy.
Google DeepMind開源WeatherNext 2與WeatherNext Cyclones天氣AI模型，同步刊登於《Nature》的研究顯示，在相同準確度下，WeatherNext Cyclones預測熱帶氣旋路徑、強度與風圈範圍平均可比現行主要模型提前超過24小時。
